H7701.def: or showd (Job 5:21) {shode}; from «07736»; violence, ravage:--desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil(-ed, -er, - ing), wasting.

H7702.def: a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. harrow a field:--break clods, harrow.

H7703.def: a primitive root; properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage:--dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), × utterly, (lay) waste.

H7704.et: from an unused root meaning to spread out
H7704.def: or saday {saw-dah'-ee}; from an unused root meaning to spread out; a field (as flat):--country, field, ground, land, soil, × wild.

H7705.def: from «07703»; a wife (as mistress of the house):--X all sorts, musical instrument.

H7707.def: from the same as «07704» and «0217»; spreader of light; Shedejur, an Israelite:--Shedeur.

H7708.def: plural from the same as «07704»; flats; Siddim, a valley in Palestine:--Siddim.

H7709.def: apparently from «07704»; a cultivated field; -- blasted, field.

H7713.et: from an unused root meaning to regulate
H7713.def: from an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms):--board, range.

H7714.def: probably of foreign origin; Shadrak, the Bab. name of one of Daniel's companions:--Shadrach.

H7716.et: probably from (07582) through the idea of pushing out to graze
H7716.def: or sey {say}; probably from «07582» through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat:--(lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare «02089».

H7717.et: from an unused root meaning to testify
H7717.def: from an unused root meaning to testify; a witness:--record.

H7718.et: from an unused root probably mean to blanch
H7718.def: from an unused root probably mean to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color):--onyx.

H7719.def: the same as «07718»; Shoham, an Israelite:--Shoham.

H7720.def: from the same as «05469»; a round pendant for the neck:--ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7721.et: from an unused root (akin to (05375) and (07722)) meaning to rise
H7721.def: from an unused root (akin to «05375» and «07722») meaning to rise; a rising:--arise.

H7722.et: from an unused root meaning to rush over
H7722.def: or (feminine) showtah {sho-aw'}; or shoah {sho-aw'}; from an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication, devastation:--desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

H7723.et: from the same as (07722) in the sense of desolating
H7723.def: or shav {shav}; from the same as «07722» in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain):--false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724.def: from the same as «07723»; false; Sheva, an Israelite:--Sheva.

H7725.def: a primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again:--((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) × again, (cause to) answer (+ again), × in any case (wise), × at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, × certainly, come again (back), × consider, + continually, convert, deliver (again), + deny, draw back, fetch home again, × fro, get (oneself) (back) again, × give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hin

H7726.def: from «07725»; apostate, i.e. idolatrous:--backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).

H7727.def: the same as «07726»; rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites:--Shobab.

H7728.def: from «07725»; apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen:--backsliding.

H7730.def: for «05441»; a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches:--thick boughs.

H7732.def: from the same as «07640»; overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites:--Shobal.

H7733.et: act part from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare (07662))
H7733.def: active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare «07662»); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite:--Shobek.

H7734.def: a primitive root; to retreat:--turn back.

H7735.def: a primitive root; to hedge in:--make to grow.

H7736.def: a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate:--waste.

H7737.def: a primitive root; properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.):--avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a- )like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7738.def: a primitive root; to destroy:--X substance (from the margin).

H7740.def: from «07737»; plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine:--Shaveh.

H7741.et: from the same as (07740) and the dual of (07151)
H7741.def: from the same as «07740» and the dual of «07151»; plain of a double city; Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan:--Shaveh Kiriathaim.

H7742.def: a primitive root; to muse pensively:--meditate.

H7743.def: a primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively:--bow down, incline, humble.

H7744.def: from «07743»; dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham:--Shuah.

H7746.def: the same as «07745»; Shuchah, an Israelite:--Shuah.

H7747.def: patronymic from «07744»; a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach:--Shuhite.

H7750.def: or (by permutation) cuwt {soot}; a primitive root; to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry):--turn aside to.

H7751.def: a primitive root; properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel:--go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752.def: from «07751»; a lash (literally or figuratively):--scourge, whip.

H7753.def: a primitive root; to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint):--fence, (make an) hedge (up).

H7754.def: or (feminine) sowkah {so-kaw'}; from «07753»; a branch (as interleaved):--bough.

H7755.def: or Sokoh {so-ko'}; or Sowkow {so-ko'}; from «07753»; Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine:--Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7756.et: probably patronymic from a name corresponding to (07754) (fem.)
H7756.def: probably patronymic from a name corresponding to 7754 (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah:--Suchathite.

H7757.et: from an unused root meaning to hang down
H7757.def: from an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge:--hem, skirt, train.

H7758.def: or sheylal (Micah 1:8) {shay-lawl'}; from «07997»; nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive:--spoiled, stripped.

H7759.def: from «07999»; peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen:--Shulamite.

H7760.def: or siym {seem}; a primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically):--X any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, + disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, + name, × on, ordain, order, + paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), + regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, + stedfastly, take, × tell, + tread down, ((over-))turn, × wholly, work.

H7761.pos:
1. to set, make, appoint
    1. (P'al)
      1. to make, make decree, set out (decree)
      2. to make, appoint
      3. to set, fix
    2. (Ithp'al) to be made, be set, be laid
H7761.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07760»:--+ command, give, lay, make, + name, + regard, set.

H7762.et: from an unused root meaning to exhale
H7762.def: from an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor):--garlic.

H7763.def: or Shomer {sho-mare'}; active participle of «08104»; keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites:--Shomer.

H7764.et: from an unused root meaning to rest
H7764.def: from an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; Shuni, an Israelite:--Shuni.

H7765.def: patronymic from «07764»; a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni:--Shunites.

H7766.def: probably from the same as «07764»; quietly; Shunem, a place in Pal:--Shunem.

H7767.def: patrial from «07766»; a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem:--Shunamite.

H7768.def: a primitive root; properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble):--cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7770.def: the same as «07769»; Shua, a Canaanite:--Shua, Shuah.

H7771.et: from (07768) in the original sense of freedom
H7771.def: from «07768» in the original sense of freedom; a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo:--bountiful, crying, rich.

H7772.def: the same as «07771»; rich; Shoa, an Oriental people:--Shoa.

H7776.def: or shunal {shoo-awl'}; from the same as «08168»; a jackal (as a burrower):--fox.

H7777.def: the same as «07776»; Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Shual.

H7778.def: or shomer {sho-are'}: active participle of «08176» (as denominative from «08179»); a janitor:--doorkeeper, porter.

H7779.def: a primitive root; properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm:--break, bruise, cover.

H7781.def: patronymic from «08197»; a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham:--Shuphamite.

H7782.et: from (08231) in the original sense of incising
H7782.def: or shophar {sho-far'}; from «08231» in the original sense of incising; a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn:--cornet, trumpet.

H7783.def: a primitive root; to run after or over, i.e. overflow:--overflow, water.

H7785.def: from «07783»; the (lower) leg (as a runner):--hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.

H7786.def: a primitive root; properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown):--make princes, have power, reign. See «05493».

H7787.et: a primitive root [identical with (07786) through the idea of reducing to pieces
H7787.def: a primitive root (identical with «07786» through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare «04883»); to saw:--cut.

H7788.def: a primitive root; properly, to turn, i.e. travel about (as a harlot or a merchant):--go, singular See also «07891».

H7789.et: a primitive root [identical with (07788) through the idea of going round for inspection]
H7789.def: a primitive root (identical with «07788» through the idea of going round for inspection); to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for:--behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.

H7790.def: from «07889»; a foe (as lying in wait):--enemy.

H7793.def: the same as «07791»; Shur, a region of the Desert:--Shur.

H7794.def: from «07788»; a bullock (as a traveller):--bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for «07791»).

H7795.et: from (07786) in the primitive sense of (05493)
H7795.def: from «07786» in the primitive sense of «05493»; properly, a ring, i.e. (by analogy) a row (adverbially):--principal.

H7796.def: the same as «08321»; a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine:--Sorek.

H7797.def: or siys {sece}; a primitive root; to be bright, i.e. cheerful:--be glad, × greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.

H7799.def: or showshan {sho-shawn'}; or shoshan {sho- shawn'}; and (feminine) showshannah {sho-shan-naw'}; from «07797»; a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of arch. ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape): lily, Shoshannim.
